notes: Company background: Moonraker Syntax — mid-market productivity SaaS offering in-app code suggestions, repo-wide semantic search and snippet reranking. Currently using OpenAI for generation + in-house reranker for embeddings.
Goal: migrate generation + embeddings to Redwood Hosted for cost/latency advantages, then transition to Dedicated for predictable throughput and committed pricing.

Primary requirements: prompt parity for top-25 prompts, <250ms tail latency per-token on code assistant paths, embedding similarity at or above current baseline for search, EU data residency for enterprise customers, SSO + audit logs + KMS integration.
Key constraints: heavy reliance on OpenAI API param semantics (temperature, top_p, stop, function-calling); deterministic few-shot behavior for code completions required.
Timeline / recent activity:
- 2024-10-15: Intro demo (Jordan Hayes) — high-level Hosted walkthrough, streaming completions, function-calling demos.
- 2024-11-20: POC kickoff (SE Priya Kapoor) — Hosted testbed created, sample prompt corpus uploaded, embedding baseline collected.
- 2024-12-05: Security questionnaire submitted (legal + infra) — asked about audit logs, KMS, SOC2 evidence.

- 2025-01-10: POC results v1 — automatic metrics show 3% drop in code suggestion accuracy (top-1) vs OpenAI baseline; embeddings show acceptable nearest-neighbor recall but slight drift on long-tail queries.

- 2025-01-22: Deep-dive with Redwood model team — identified quantization/profile mismatch and tokenization differences affecting few-shot examples; discussed compatibility layer to map OpenAI params.
- 2025-02-01: Pricing review call — Dedicated looks favorable with 1yr commit; finance wants ARR band confirmation and showed interest in Optimize tooling for batching.
Technical notes / POC details:
- Workload: streaming completions + function-calling for structured code edits; embeddings for repo search and reranking.
- Behaviors to preserve: exact match on stop-sequences and code block formatting, deterministic few-shot outputs for code transforms, streaming latency under contention.
- Observed issues: KV cache differences causing context drift on long sessions; tokenizer alignment causing subtle token-level differences in function args; sampling variance on low-temp prompts.

- SE recommendations: enable Redwood compatibility shim (param mapping for temperature/top_p, stop handling), run POC with explicit prompt templates and canonical token normalization; try lower-quantization profile or Redwood's suggested quantization tuning.
Migration concerns / acceptance criteria:
- Prompt parity: zero-regression on top-25 high-value prompts; measurable A/B on a balanced eval set.
- Stability: consistent latency <250ms tail on 95th percentile in Hosted POC and projected for Dedicated sizing.
- Observability: token-level cost & latency breakdowns, per-route error rates, ability to trace prompts back to users (for debugging).
Sales / commercial notes:

- Initial ARR target range: $50k-$150k — finance needs exact T-shirt sizing for commit.
